# Code of conduct

This is a project about waving at strangers from a car, which only works if being here is
pleasant. So:

- Assume the other person is driving, tired, or on a phone. Read their report generously.
- Argue about the code and the road, not the person.
- No harassment, no slurs, no sexual attention, no dragging somebody's identity into a
  technical thread. Not in issues, pull requests, commits or code.
- Do not post anybody's location, plate, car, address or drive — yours or a stranger's.
  A screenshot from a real car is welcome; check what is on it first.
- When somebody says a thread has stopped being about the work, believe them.

This applies to everyone in the repository, maintainers included.

## If something goes wrong

Write to **contact@teslawave.app**. Reports are read by the maintainer, kept private, and
answered. Depending on what happened, the response is a word in private, an edited or deleted
comment, or a block from the repository — with a reason given, and one chance to put it right
where that is reasonable.

There is no committee to appeal to. It is one person's side project, and this is the standard
it is held to as well.
